whatIs.question: What is CFit?
whatIs.answer: CFit is a Caribbean football intelligence platform designed to organize player information and connect the football ecosystem through structured profiles.

whoCanCreate.question: Who can create a player profile?
whoCanCreate.answer: Any football player in the Caribbean can create a profile, from community and school players to academy and club players.

whatInfo.question: What information do I need to register?
whatInfo.answer: You will need your basic personal details, position, preferred foot, height and weight, your current club or academy, and your playing history.

addVideos.question: Can I add videos to my player profile?
addVideos.answer: Yes. You can add links to your available match footage and highlight videos so coaches and scouts can see you play.

verification.question: How does the CFit verification process work?
verification.answer: After you submit your profile, the CFit team reviews your information for accuracy and completeness before it becomes part of the verified ecosystem.

recommend.question: Can a coach or academy recommend me?
recommend.answer: Yes. Coaches and academies on CFit can add coach information and recommendations that support your player profile.

update.question: How can I update my player information?
update.answer: You can log in to your account at any time to update your details, playing history, statistics, and video links.

faq.description: A little more clarity before your academy joins.

whoCanRegister.question: Who can register as a coach or academy?
whoCanRegister.answer: Football coaches, academies, clubs, and youth programs across the Caribbean can register their organization on CFit.

approval.question: Does my organization need admin approval?
approval.answer: Yes. Every organization is reviewed by the CFit team before full dashboard access and player management tools become available.

invite.question: How can I invite players to CFit?
invite.answer: Once approved, you receive a unique registration link and QR code that you can share with your players and their parents.

track.question: Can I track my players' registration status?
track.answer: Yes. Your dashboard shows who has been invited, who has registered, and which profiles are complete or verified.

recommendation.question: How does the player recommendation feature work?
recommendation.answer: You can select an associated player, choose a recommendation type, and add comments about their ability, development, and football background.

multiple.question: Can I manage multiple players through my organization?
multiple.answer: Yes. All players who register through your invitation are associated with your organization and can be managed from one view.

intelligence.question: Can coaches view CFit's private scouting intelligence?
intelligence.answer: No. Recommendations add context to a player's profile, but CFit's private evaluations and internal scouting intelligence remain confidential.

whichOrganizations.question: What types of organizations can partner with CFit?
whichOrganizations.answer: Football clubs, academies, associations, youth development programs, and development organizations that share our vision are welcome to start a conversation.

expressInterest.question: How can our organization express partnership interest?
expressInterest.answer: Submit the partnership inquiry form on this page with details about your organization and the areas you would like to explore.

guarantee.question: Does submitting an inquiry guarantee a partnership?
guarantee.answer: No. Every inquiry is reviewed by the CFit team, and any collaboration is discussed based on shared goals and suitability.

academies.question: Can football academies participate in CFit?
academies.answer: Yes. Academies can register as an organization, invite their players, and take part in the wider CFit ecosystem.

connect.question: How does CFit connect different football organizations?
connect.answer: CFit provides a shared platform where organizations, coaches, players, and scouts interact through structured information and role-based access.

playerInformation.question: Can partners access player information?
